[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cashew cream and nutritional yeast can add richness, creaminess, and cheesy flavors to vegan dishes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended recipes using cashew cream:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Vegan Mac and Cheese: Blend cashew cream with lemon juice, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, and spices; toss with cooked macaroni and top with nutritional yeast.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Cashew Cream Indian Korma: Blend cashew cream with coconut milk, spices, and herbs; simmer with protein and serve over basmati rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Vegan Lasagna: Replace ricotta with cashew cream mixed with garlic, lemon juice, and herbs; layer with marinara sauce and noodles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended recipes using nutritional yeast:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Vegan Cheesy Broccoli Soup: Blend nutritional yeast with cashew cream, broccoli, garlic, and lemon juice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Nutritional Yeast "Cheese" Sauce: Blend nutritional yeast with lemon juice, garlic powder, and olive oil.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Vegan Quesadillas: Add nutritional yeast to filling with sautéed onions, bell peppers, and beans; use cashew cream as a substitute for sour cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended recipes that combine cashew cream and nutritional yeast:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Vegan Creamy Mushroom Pasta: Blend cashew cream with sautéed mushrooms, garlic, and nutritional yeast.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Vegan Cauliflower Gnocchi with Creamy Sauce: Use cashew cream and nutritional yeast for a creamy sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Vegan Stuffed Bell Peppers: Fill with quinoa, black beans, diced tomatoes, and a cashew cream sauce infused with nutritional yeast.
